newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-WALES RECALL GIGGS, RUSH OUT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WALES RECALL GIGGS, RUSH OUT.

text.p: Manchester United's Ryan Giggs was recalled on Thursday to the Welsh squad to face Belgium in a World Cup qualifier on March 29.
The left winger was injured for Wales' last match, a goalless friendly against Ireland.

Veteran scorer Ian Rush missed out again. Rush, capped 73 times for Wales during a glittering career with Liverpool and Juventus, has not played in any 1998 World Cup qualifiers following a dispute with the Welsh management.
Everton's veteran goalkeeper Neville Southall was named after being dropped for the Ireland match.
Wales are second in European group seven, a point ahead of Belgium, who have played two matches fewer.
Goalkeepers: Neville Southall (Everton), Mark Crossley (Nottingham Forest), Andy Marriott (Wrexham).

Defenders: Paul Jones (Stockport), Mark Bowen (West Ham), Steve Jenkins (Huddersfield), Robert Page (Watford), Karl Ready (Queens Park Rangers), Kit Symons (Manchester City), Barry Horne (Birmingham), Vinnie Jones (Wimbledon), Alan Neilson (Southampton).

Midfielders: Adrian Williams (Wolves), Mark Pembridge (Sheffield Wednesday), John Robinson (Charlton), Rob Savage (Crewe), Ceri Hughes (Luton), Marcus Browning (Huddersfield), Clayton Blackmore (Middlesbrough), David Phillips (Nottingham Forest).

Forwards: Gary Speed (Everton), Ryan Giggs (Manchester United), John Hartson (West Ham), Nathan Blake (Bolton), Andy Legg (Birmingham), Mark Hughes (Chelsea), Dean Saunders (Nottingham Forest), Gareth Taylor (Sheffield United), Iwan Roberts (Wolves).
